current_formal_task_id.definition: The most recent formal task represented by the canonical Current task identity source.
current_formal_task_id.derivation: Read the canonical task identity string exactly; do not infer it from prose, branch names or commit messages.
current_formal_task_id.lifecycle: Advances only through the authorized canonical Current task advancement transaction.
current_formal_task_id.compatibility: No compatibility alias; this is the named source role.

current_formal_task_ordinal.definition: The integer ordinal parsed from current_formal_task_id.
current_formal_task_ordinal.derivation: parse_task_id(current_formal_task_id).ordinal using the deterministic provider-neutral task identity parser.
current_formal_task_ordinal.lifecycle: Derived on every validation and projection build; never independently authored.
current_formal_task_ordinal.compatibility: Canonical named ordinal for the formal task role.

latest_architecture_changing_task_id.definition: The most recent task that changed architecture identity; it may differ from the current formal task.
latest_architecture_changing_task_id.derivation: Read the canonical architecture-task identity string exactly; do not infer it from the current formal task.
latest_architecture_changing_task_id.lifecycle: Advances only when a task has explicit architecture identity impact and the canonical task identity source records it.
latest_architecture_changing_task_id.compatibility: No compatibility alias; this is the named source role.

latest_architecture_task_ordinal.definition: The integer ordinal parsed from latest_architecture_changing_task_id.
latest_architecture_task_ordinal.derivation: parse_task_id(latest_architecture_changing_task_id).ordinal using the deterministic provider-neutral task identity parser.
latest_architecture_task_ordinal.lifecycle: Derived on every validation and projection build; never independently authored.
latest_architecture_task_ordinal.compatibility: Canonical named ordinal for the architecture-changing task role.

current_method_version.definition: The current iteration-method version declared by ITERATION.md.
current_method_version.derivation: Extract the current method marker from the declared source; do not bind it to a task ordinal.
current_method_version.lifecycle: Advances only through a method-version change, independently of formal task and architecture task ordinals.

current_iteration_boundary.definition: Deprecated compatibility alias for current_formal_task_ordinal in Current projections; it is not an architecture ordinal or an independent synchronization point.
current_iteration_boundary.derivation: Exact deterministic alias: current_iteration_boundary = current_formal_task_ordinal. No independent numeric source is permitted.
current_iteration_boundary.lifecycle: Retained only for backward compatibility; new consumers must use the named formal and architecture ordinal fields.

current_iteration_boundary.historical_records: Historical receipts and changelog entries retain captured values and must be labeled Historical; they are not rewritten or reinterpreted as the Current source.
current_iteration_boundary.new_consumers: Must consume current_formal_task_ordinal or latest_architecture_task_ordinal by name.

separation.invalid_rule: A difference between current_formal_task_ordinal and latest_architecture_task_ordinal is not a validation error; forcing equality is invalid.

claim_ceiling: Repository-local iteration identity and compatibility semantics only; no external truth, production readiness, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance is inferred.
